methodologyNotes: Pricing re-verified on 2026-06-18 by fetching each vendor's official pricing page via WebFetch (testgorilla.com/pricing, bryq.com/pricing, canditech.io/pricing, testdome.com/pricing, imocha.io/talent-acquisition-pricing, vervoe.com/pricing, testpartnership.com/pricing.html). RULE APPLIED: a null beats a guess — any plan whose dollar amount is not actually published on the official page has monthlyUsd=null, even where third-party aggregators quote a figure. Canditech's official page shows a feature matrix with NO dollar amounts, so its previously-listed $75 Team / $100 Pro aggregator figures were nulled. iMocha is contact-sales only with a verified 7-day trial; speculative ~$400/mo aggregator figures were removed. Vervoe and Test Partnership are quote-only. Toggl Hire excluded (product shutting down, signups closed). Hire Success and Maki People excluded (no self-serve published prices). accessedAt 2026-06-18.

vendors.name: TestGorilla
vendors.provenance: Fetched testgorilla.com/pricing on 2026-06-18; plan names, prices, and credit structure taken directly from that page and re-verified. Integration list fetched from testgorilla.com/ats-integrations on the same date.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Forever-free. 10 free credits per month (1 credit = 1 candidate assessed); access to 5 essential skills tests only (Big 5, Problem Solving, Communication, Time Management, Motivation); AI video interviews; resume scoring; 1 full-access seat; no credit card required.

plans.name: Core
plans.notes: Billed annually at $1,704/year ($142/mo equivalent); 350+ skills tests library; video questions (TestGorilla library only); resume scoring; qualifying questions; up to 5 custom questions per assessment; talent sourcing (2M+ candidates); analytics and reporting; 2 full-access seats.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: Starts from $400/month billed annually (from $4,800/year); scales with hiring volume. Includes everything in Core plus: AI interviews with full customization and auto-scoring, job simulations, custom tests, coding challenges, ID verification, up to 20 custom questions per assessment, ATS integrations, API access, white-labeling, dedicated customer success manager, unlimited full-access seats.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing; includes everything in Plus plus scientific validation, security reviews, and tailored agreements.

keyFeatures: AI-powered one-way video interviews with auto-scoring
